author: Skquid
body:
Part 1: About You

What is your age?

15

What is your Discord ID? (If you don’t have Discord, create an account and join the Avicus Discord server before answering this question.)

JS#7262

How active can you be in order to contribute to the team?

Probably 5-7 hours a week, depending on school

What attributes distinguish yourself from other applicants that qualify you to be a builder?

I am experienced in aesthetics and structure, as I've built many buildings in my days, such as helping to build Pagoda Network's lobby (Koja's server)
Part 2: Skills

What do you think is a necessity in order to hone your map building skills in terms of gameplay?

A builder needs to be able to know what themes are to be used, the order of things to do, and have the ability to create a schedule , as well as to have the ability to create maps with excellent aesthetics to please the eye, but keeping gameplay at a satisfactory level 

How comfortable are you with Avicus XML when it comes to creating it and analyzing it to fix possible errors?

I have limited experience with XML, it might take some time to finish it if I had to do the XML

As builder, would you focus on building maps, creating XML, or both?

Buidling maps and giving feedback.

Part 3: Past Experience

Provide the links for the threads of two maps that you have submitted to the Avicus forums.


https://avicus.net/maps/map/mine-your-own-business
https://avicus.net/forums/discussions/d41fd03b2

New map coming soon

Another new map may or may not be coming at a very further date, 
Mygeeto


Have you had any past experience with building maps or creating XML, other than with the two maps linked above? If so, explain.

I have helped out with 3 of Pagoda's lobbies, and have started to build a massive map for Avicus although it is currently postponed/paused due to a lack of motivation for such project (Map helpers left) 
Part 4: Self Reflection

Why do you want to be a builder?

I want to create maps for avicus at a more sufficient speed, as well as help out others on their plans of making their own maps.

How do you think you will help the map development team?

I feel as though I can help by building details, structures, and functions to help bring a map to life, as well as give others constructive feedback on their own maps.
